_notes: Narrator for the hazard perception tests: "Publican Yorkshire", a designed voice (cheerful, warm, middle-aged northern British publican) in the team's ElevenLabs account, so the API key in .env must belong to that account. Settings favour keeping the British accent steady (stability and similarity near the voice's defaults, modest style); lower stability or higher style makes the read livelier but can drift the accent. v3Tag is only sent when modelId is eleven_v3. Changing anything here re-records every line on the next `npm run audio:generate`.
